simulation.contactTiming: Raw callbacks occur within the supplied [startTick,endTick] 120 Hz step. Incoming/outgoing are whole-step projectile velocities, not isolated per-contact impulses. Simultaneous contacts share a bracket.
simulation.normalConvention: Unmodified Havok event.normal; projectileIsCollider preserves the event ordering. No inferred oriented normal or impulse.

summary.caveat: Coverage applies only to this explicit grid. Untouched does not mean unreachable; a frequent sequence is not evidence of enjoyment.

resources.limits: World-only NullEngine counts/timing, not draw calls, frame rate or phone performance.
